description: Knowledge base for the Code Review Pyramid — a framework for structuring code reviews across five layers prioritized by cost-of-change. Use when the user asks how to approach a code review, wants to understand what to focus on in a review, asks about review priorities, or references "the pyramid". Also use when another skill needs a structured review framework (e.g. review-changes loads it to apply consistent layer priorities and questions).
